cards.fr: What three parts make up triple assessment of a breast lump?
cards.bk: Clinical examination, breast imaging and tissue diagnosis by image-guided core biopsy.

cards.fr: Why are both breasts imaged when breast cancer is suspected?
cards.bk: Up to 3% of patients have hidden cancer in the other breast.

cards.fr: Which adhesion protein is lost in invasive lobular carcinoma?
cards.bk: E-cadherin. Lobular cancer is usually ER positive and HER2 negative.

cards.fr: Which breast cancer subtype lacks ER, PR and HER2?
cards.bk: Triple-negative cancer. It relies on chemotherapy, with immunotherapy added, and carries a poorer prognosis.
